back: Profit = revenue − total costs. A negative result is a loss.
Gross profit = revenue − cost of sales; profit = gross profit − expenses.
Profit kept in the business instead of being paid to the owners; a source of finance with no interest.
Reward for risk, source of finance, measure of success, attracts investors and lenders.
Income from selling goods or services: selling price × quantity sold. Also called sales or turnover.
A profitable business can be short of cash, for example after credit sales or buying equipment.
New businesses may aim to survive; charities, social enterprises and public-sector bodies aim to provide services.
ZIMSEC: net profit and income statement. Cambridge: profit and statement of profit or loss.
